private_note: I can't know or even estimate which group is mine, and the result binds my household for a generation with no second chance. So I'm judging each plan by its worst case. Hazel guarantees at least 41, Birch 36, Alder 32, Today 22 and Cedar 15. Cedar's upside is real but its floor is the worst. I'd rather the convention fail than adopt Cedar. I'll stay flexible between Hazel, Birch and Alder to reach 9 votes.
statement: Fellow delegates, none of us knows where we will land, and none of us can even estimate the odds. Whatever we choose will bind us for a generation, and we won't meet again. Under those conditions I think the sensible question is: if I turn out to be in the lowest group, what do I get? Hazel guarantees the highest floor, 41 thousand, almost double today's 22. Birch and Alder also raise the floor a lot. Cedar's top-group gains are tempting, but under Cedar the lowest group drops to 15, below even today and with no health coverage guaranteed. Any one of us could be in that group. I rank Hazel first, then Birch, then Alder. We need nine votes to change anything. I'm open to settling on whichever of Hazel, Birch or Alder can reach nine, and I'd ask you all to keep that same range open.
